title: never finds transmitter
body:
Hello.
I'm currently using a Samsung Galaxy A5 2017 (sm-a520w) running lineage os 17.1 (android 10)
I am using the dexcom g6, and currently running the b978bec-2020.11.27 version of xdrip.
In my android settings, I have allowed xdrip to access to all permissions, turned off the battery optimization and allow for the modification of system settings, installation of unknown apps, and wear os.
I have uploaded a screenshot of my logs, seemingly no matter my settings I get DexTimeKeeper telling me I do not have a valid timestamp for the transmitter.
Secondly, I have the error from rxandroidble2 with status 8 (insufficient authorization or gatt connection timeout).

![Screenshot_20201130-212320_xDrip+](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/45549041/100689589-bd3a9500-3352-11eb-85f2-040929247f90.png)
.

comments.body:
One first comment: 
I'm also using a Samsung Galaxy A5 2017, but (sm-a520F), and running Android version 8.0.0, 
and I am using the dexcom g6 with xdrip+ for many months, with no problems. 
So maybe your Android version 10 doesn't understand/accept xdrip+ and produces severe faults? JM

> 
> 
> One first comment:
> I'm also using a Samsung Galaxy A5 2017, but (sm-a520F), and running Android version 8.0.0,
> and I am using the dexcom g6 with xdrip+ for many months, with no problems.
> So maybe your Android version 10 doesn't understand/accept xdrip+ and produces severe faults? JM

That may be a possibility. When I was running the stock rom (the same as you listed before) I was also able to run the dexcom app or xdrip with no problems. 
Since installing lineage, the dexcom app simply complains about transmitter not found, and xdrip gives me the above messages. I am however able to use my wear os watch (Ticwatch E) as a collector with no problems.
Is there a way to go about determining if it is my custom rom that is the problem?

@Andifferous xDrip indeed found the transmitter but has some authentication/paring issues. I'm also on LineageOS 17.1 on a Samsung S4 and S4 mini. It sometimes work but currently not. Will try to debug it.

@Andifferous Are you still having this problem?
If yes, can you list all your settings on the following three pages?

Settings -> G5/G6 Debug Settings
Settings -> Less common settings -> Bluetooth Settings
Settings -> Less common settings -> Other misc options


Alternatively, you can see the recommended settings on facebook:
https://www.facebook.com/groups/xDripG5/permalink/4838757582864365
